component: Calder Find Your Fit / Fitment Finder

normalization.method: Desktop X dimensions normalized by 1920/2048. Vertical composition judged primarily from local hero-boundary/tab/panel relationships because the captures have different page/crop heights.

corrections.reference_requirement: Tabs overlap the hero/light transition while the main panel starts approximately 19 px below that transition in the 2048 px reference.
corrections.reference_measurement: hero boundary≈188; tabs top≈118 (≈70 px overlap); panel top≈207
corrections.current_implementation: hero/light boundary≈380; tabs top≈290 (≈90 px overlap); panel top≈364 (≈16 px above boundary)
corrections.delta: Tab overlap is ≈20 px too deep and, more importantly, the panel begins ≈35 px too high relative to the transition (reference +19 px below versus implementation ≈16 px above).
corrections.recommended_correction: Preserve the restored direct hero→tabs→panel composition, but shift the panel/tab relationship so the panel begins just below the hero/light boundary while tabs retain the reference-like overlap.
corrections.acceptance_condition: At desktop, tab overlap and panel start reproduce the reference transition relationship within ordinary raster/browser tolerance.

corrections.reference_requirement: Shell x≈74–1978, width≈1904 px (92.97%). At 1920 proportional width target≈1785 px, x≈69–1854.
corrections.reference_measurement: normalized target≈1785 px wide at x≈69
corrections.current_implementation: shell visually spans approximately x≈46–1874, width≈1828 px
corrections.delta: Implementation is ≈43 px wider than normalized target and starts ≈23 px too far left; right edge is ≈20 px too far right.
corrections.recommended_correction: Reduce desktop shell width and restore approximately symmetric reference-derived horizontal inset.
corrections.acceptance_condition: At 1920 capture width, shell is approximately 1785 px wide with left/right position close to normalized reference.

corrections.reference_requirement: Large technical wheel line-art occupies the center-right finder area (reference x≈1000–1518, y≈207–500), with flowing contour lines behind the finder.
corrections.reference_measurement: wheel art width≈518 px in reference; centered immediately left of vehicle divider and visibly cropped/faded
corrections.current_implementation: Current render uses a comparatively small concentric/radar-style circular drawing centered mainly in/behind the selected-vehicle region, plus faint diagonal/flow lines near the divider.
corrections.delta: Artwork subject, scale, placement and crop materially differ. The signature large wheel drawing behind the center-right finder is still absent.
corrections.recommended_correction: Use/reproduce the approved technical wheel line-art composition at reference-like scale and center-right placement; keep contour lines separate and subordinate. Do not substitute the radar/concentric-circle motif for the wheel drawing.
corrections.acceptance_condition: Side-by-side comparison shows a large cropped wheel line drawing in the same center-right zone and similar visual balance as the approved reference.

corrections.reference_requirement: Reference tabs are approximately 349×92 and 387×92 px at 2048 width, with large slanted adjoining faces and substantial label/icon scale.
corrections.current_implementation: Tabs are approximately x46–239 and x239–471, about 193 px and 232 px wide, with height≈74 px.
corrections.delta: Angled seam is now present, but both tabs are materially narrower and somewhat shorter than the reference.
corrections.recommended_correction: Retain the corrected angled geometry but increase tab widths/heights toward normalized reference proportions; preserve active underline and shared seam.
corrections.acceptance_condition: Desktop tab footprints and label/icon visual weight closely match the approved reference, not merely the angled silhouette.

corrections.reference_requirement: At 2048 reference scale: controls≈201/217/218/249×70 px; CTA≈365×80 px. Normalized to 1920: ≈188/203/204/233×66; CTA≈342×75.
corrections.reference_measurement: differentiated field widths and CTA larger/taller than fields
corrections.current_implementation: Fields appear approximately 200/217/217/249 px and ≈70 px high; CTA≈365×70 px.
corrections.delta: Field widths remain closer to unscaled 2048 measurements than normalized 1920 targets; CTA is too wide and not visibly taller than fields.
corrections.recommended_correction: Normalize field/CTA footprints to viewport scale and restore the reference's CTA height emphasis relative to controls.
corrections.acceptance_condition: At 1920 width, differentiated fields and CTA have reference-proportional widths, gaps, and CTA height emphasis.

corrections.reference_requirement: Selected-vehicle region≈24% of shell, separated by a strong vertical divider; internal content begins with generous inset and the artwork remains primarily left of the divider.
corrections.reference_measurement: divider x≈1521 in 2048 reference; normalized x≈1426
corrections.current_implementation: divider visually appears around x≈1445, while the circular decorative motif extends strongly through the vehicle region and competes with its content.
corrections.delta: Divider is reasonably near normalized target, but region composition is altered by the incorrect artwork placement and denser/smaller content treatment.
corrections.recommended_correction: Keep divider near current normalized position, but restore reference artwork boundary/placement and reference-like selected-vehicle spacing/visual isolation.
corrections.acceptance_condition: Vehicle region reads as a distinct right-side panel with reference-like whitespace, divider structure, status hierarchy and actions.
